<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex21022024-10-2514-47-21" status="finalized"><lb n="54a4"/> gzhan yang sa ma thob pa la byas na gzhan la ni
            ma <abbr>yin no</abbr> zhes bya ba'i gzhan gyi sgra'i don sa thob pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la
            mi spyod pa la 'gro bas don ma 'brel par 'gyur ba dang | lab ta 'buM mi zhes bya ba'i skad
            la dgag pa'i tshig med pas sa ma thob par byed pa 'khrul pa kho na'o zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha 1</rs> 'chad do
            || 
            'on kyang 'dir pha rol phyin drug spyod pa zhes bya ba khyad par nye bar <lb n="54a5"/> bzung pa dang | sngar brjod pa'i gzhung gzhan la brten nas kyang 'di ni sa ma thob
            pa'i dbang du byas pa'o zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">kho bo</rs>s rtogs te | mig dang mi ldan ba'i rtogs pa la su
            zhig yid rtod par byed zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3876">nyang bran</rs> 'chad do || </seg></TEI>
